library(tidyverse)

```{r}

batting <- read.csv("C:/Users/hlamp/Downloads/Batting.csv")

```

```{r}

career_batting <- batting %>%
  group_by(playerID) %>%
  summarize(
    G = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    AB = sum(AB, na.rm = TRUE),
    R = sum(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    H = sum(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    X2B = sum(X2B, na.rm = TRUE),
    X3B = sum(X3B, na.rm = TRUE),
    HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    RBI = sum(RBI, na.rm = TRUE),
    SB = sum(SB, na.rm = TRUE),
    CS = sum(CS, na.rm = TRUE),
    BB = sum(BB, na.rm = TRUE),
    SO = sum(SO, na.rm = TRUE),
    IBB = sum(IBB, na.rm = TRUE),
    HBP = sum(HBP, na.rm = TRUE),
    SH = sum(SH, na.rm = TRUE),
    SF = sum(SF, na.rm = TRUE),
    GIDP = sum(GIDP, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

career_batting$PA <- career_batting$AB+career_batting$BB+career_batting$HBP+career_batting$SH+career_batting$SF

career_batting$BA <- career_batting$H/career_batting$AB

career_batting$OBP <- (career_batting$H+career_batting$BB+career_batting$HBP)/career_batting$PA

career_batting$SLG <- ((career_batting$H-(career_batting$X2B+career_batting$X3B+career_batting$HR))+(career_batting$X2B*2)+(career_batting$X3B*3)+(career_batting$HR*4))/career_batting$AB

```


```{r}

pitching <- read.csv("C:/Users/hlamp/Downloads/Pitching.csv")

career_pitching <- pitching %>%
  group_by(playerID) %>%
  summarise(
    W = sum(W, na.rm = TRUE),
    L = sum(L, na.rm = TRUE),
    ERA = sum(ERA, na.rm = TRUE),
    G = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    GS = sum(GS, na.rm = TRUE),
    GF = sum(GF, na.rm = TRUE),
    CG = sum(CG, na.rm = TRUE),
    SHO = sum(SHO, na.rm = TRUE),
    SV = sum(SV, na.rm = TRUE),
    H = sum(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    R = sum(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    ER = sum(ER, na.rm = TRUE),
    HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    BB = sum(BB, na.rm = TRUE),
    IBB = sum(IBB, na.rm = TRUE),
    SO = sum(SO, na.rm = TRUE),
    HBP = sum(HBP, na.rm = TRUE),
    BK = sum(BK, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

career_pitching$IP <- career_pitching$IPouts/3
career_pitching$WLpercentage <- career_pitching$W/(career_pitching$W+career_pitching$L)


```

```{r}

write.csv(career_batting, "careerbatting.csv", row.names = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

write.csv(career_pitching, "careerpitching.csv", row.names = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

```


```{r}

fielding <- read.csv("C:/Users/hlamp/Downloads/Fielding.csv")

player_primary_pos <- fielding %>%
  group_by(playerID, POS) %>%
  summarise(total_games = sum(G), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(playerID) %>%
  slice_max(total_games, n=1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(playerID, primary_pos = POS)
  

```


```{r}

write.csv(player_primary_pos, "career_position.csv", row.names = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

```
